snippet.title: Knock'Em Out - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Knock'Em Out is a physics-based multiplayer fighting video game in which you must smash your friends in the most bloody and comical way possible while trying not to get your head cut off.

There are dangerous cutting mechanisms and objects scattered around the stage that can cut off body parts such as your arms, legs... But as long as you don't lose your head... you can keep on fighting!

Get Knock'Em Out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2192900/KnockEm_Out/

#indiegames #ragdolls
